title: Binary Error-Correcting & Constant-Weight Codes: maximize code size A(n, d) and A(n, d, w)
description: Pure Lean 4.36.0 (zero Mathlib) certified optimization of binary block codes A(n, d) and constant-weight codes A(n, d, w) across 16 classical open Brouwer/Rosin frontier parameters. `CodingBounds/Spec.lean` formally defines semantic `Fin n → Bool` Hamming weight and distance and proves end-to-end soundness of a carry-free 32-bit SWAR popcount evaluator (`popcount32`) verified inside the Lean 4 kernel (`decide +kernel`). Pinned to `williamechols/cwc-seeded-tabu-search@4f0bf18` (MIT).

tasks.title: Maximize binary code size A(17, 8) (baseline 28)
tasks.description: Submit a binary error-correcting code of length 17 and minimum Hamming distance 8 in `CodingBounds/Code17_8.lean` (`CodingBounds.score_code_17_8` and `CodingBounds.words_code_17_8`), seeded with a constructive greedy code of size 28 (open Brouwer frontier: 36–37). Frozen `CodingBounds/BoundCode17_8.lean` kernel-verifies codeword bounds (`< 2^17`), pairwise distinctness, and minimum Hamming distance `≥ 8` via SWAR `popcount32` and `decide +kernel`, certifying `ValidBinaryCode 17 8 score_code_17_8`.
